info.name: Aquiline Order Sync Service
info.description:
# Aquiline Order Sync Service

A small, **stateless** Node.js/Express service that syncs Amazon orders into the **Aquiline Customer Integration API** and registers them for Aquiline tracking.

- **No database, no cache.** Every request calls Aquiline directly and returns the result.
- **No auth on this service.** The Aquiline integration token (`AQUILINE_TOKEN_ID` / `AQUILINE_TOKEN_SECRET`) is in the service's `.env` and is attached to Aquiline calls by the service. You never send it from Postman.
- **No retries.** Failures come back straight away. The caller decides whether to retry.

---

## Quick start

1. Import **aquiline-tracker.json** (this collection). All variables are on the collection.
2. If the service isn't on `http://localhost:3000`, change `baseUrl` under **Collection → Variables**.
3. Start the service: `cp .env.example .env`, fill in the token, then run `npm install && npm run dev`.
4. Send **Health → Health Check**. You should get `{ "success": true, "status": "ok" }`.
5. For a normal order, use **Orders → Sync Full**. It does everything in one call.

Every request has **saved examples** (the *Examples* dropdown on the right of the request) showing success, skip and failure responses. You can look at them without calling anything.

---

## The order lifecycle

```
 ensure profile ──► upsert order ──► assign tracking ──► upload tracking HTML
 (create if missing)  (idempotent)    (gets AQUA number)   (refresh 1-2x/day)
```

| Endpoint | Covers |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/orders/sync-full` | **All four steps** for one order, with checks before each step and a per-step report. **Use this by default.** |
| `POST /api/orders/sync` | Ensure profile + upsert only (supports **many** orders in one call). |
| `POST /api/tracking/assign` | Assign tracking only. |
| `POST /api/tracking/upload-html` | Upload tracking HTML only (the daily refresh). |
| `GET /api/tracking/:profileId/:orderId` | Read-only lookup of the AQUA number and status. |
| `GET /api/health` | Liveness check. |

---

## Response conventions

**Success:** `{ "success": true, ... }` with HTTP `200`.

**Error** (every endpoint except `sync-full`):
```json
{ "success": false, "stage": "<where it failed>", "error": "<message>", "details": { } }
```
`details` holds validation messages, or the raw Aquiline error body (for example `problemCode`).

**`sync-full`** always returns a **per-step report** (see that request's docs), both when it succeeds and when a step fails.

### Error stages and HTTP codes

| `stage` | Meaning | HTTP |
|---|---|---|
| `validation` | Bad request body. Aquiline was **not** called. | 400 |
| `not_found` | Unknown route. | 404 |
| `get_tracking` | Order not found in Aquiline (lookup endpoint only). | 404 |
| `check_profile`, `create_profile`, `upsert_order`, `assign_tracking`, `upload_html`, `get_tracking` | An Aquiline call failed. | **402** paid plan required · **502** Aquiline returned an error · **504** Aquiline didn't respond (timeout) · **500** unexpected |

---

## Cost / plan usage

- **Assign tracking counts against your Aquiline plan** (`planUsed` / `planRemaining`, and possibly `chargedCents`).
- `sync-full` first checks whether the order already has an AQUA number and **skips assign** if it does, so retries are safe.
- `POST /api/tracking/assign` does **not** check first. Calling it twice for the same order calls Aquiline's assign twice. Aquiline's docs don't say whether that is charged again, so avoid it.
- Upsert is idempotent (keyed by `marketplaceOrderId`) and safe to repeat.

---

## Variables

Edit them under **Collection → Variables**:

| Variable | Default |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:3000` |
| `profileId` | `amazon-us-main` |
| `orderId` | `113-5870630-5330667` |

request.description:
Returns `200` when the service is running. It does **not** call Aquiline, so it says nothing about Aquiline reachability or the token.

Use it for load-balancer and container health checks.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Sync orders into Aquiline. **Sync Full** is the one-call lifecycle for a single order. **Sync Order** does profile + upsert for one or many orders without assigning tracking.

request.description:
**The main endpoint.** Handles one order end to end: **ensure profile → upsert order → assign tracking → upload tracking HTML**. It checks conditions before each step and returns a report for every step.

| # | Step | Runs when | Skipped with `reason` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ensure_profile` | always (creates the profile if missing) | — |
| 2 | `upsert_order` | always | — |
| 3 | `assign_tracking` | a tracking URL exists **and** the order has no AQUA number yet | `no_tracking` · `already_assigned` (no charge) |
| 4 | `upload_html` | `html` sent **and** the order has an AQUA number | `no_html` · `not_assigned` |

### Aquiline calls (in order)
`GET /v1/profiles/{id}` → (`POST /v1/profiles` if missing) → `POST .../orders/upsert` → `GET .../orders/{orderId}` (already assigned?) → `POST .../orders/{orderId}/assign` → `POST .../orders/{orderId}/tracking-html`

### Body

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `profileId` | ✅ | Your id for the Amazon account, e.g. `amazon-us-main`. Reused if it already exists. |
| `accountOrigin` | ✅ | Always `"amazon"`. |
| `label` | | Display name. |
| `marketplaceHost` | | e.g. `www.amazon.com`. |
| `retailer` | | e.g. `amazon-us`. |
| `amazonAccountEmail` | | Must be a valid email. Helps Aquiline's HTML refresh. |
| `storeAddress` | | Ship-from / return address. **Needed before Aquiline can assign tracking**, so set it on the first call. |
| `order` | ✅ | **One** order object (same fields as a Sync Order `orders[]` item). `order.trackingUrl` is used for assign unless `tracking.trackingUrl` is set. |
| `tracking` | | Optional overrides for the assign call: `trackingUrl`, `retailer`, `marketplaceHost`, `sourceTracking`, `amazonCustomerId`, `shippingAddress`. |
| `html` | | HTML of the live Amazon **tracking** page (ship-track / progress tracker) from a signed-in session. **Not** the order-details page. Max request size 5 MB. |
| `amazonCustomerId` | | Optional, passed to assign and HTML upload. |

### How the assign call is built
Each field comes from `tracking` if set, otherwise from the order or top level:
- `trackingUrl`: `tracking.trackingUrl`, otherwise `order.trackingUrl`.
- `sourceTracking`: `tracking.sourceTracking`, otherwise `order.sourceTracking`.
- `shippingAddress`: `tracking.shippingAddress`, otherwise `order.shippingAddress`.
- `retailer` / `marketplaceHost`: `tracking.*`, otherwise the top-level fields.

### Response: per-step report

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "profileId": "...",
  "orderId": "...",
  "failedStep": null,
  "steps": {
    "ensure_profile":  { "status": "done", "created": false },
    "upsert_order":    { "status": "done", "suggestAmazonEmailFetch": false },
    "assign_tracking": { "status": "done", "aquilineNumber": "AQUA...", "chargedCents": 0, "planRemaining": 287 },
    "upload_html":     { "status": "done", "outcome": "accepted", "trackingUpdateStatus": "processing", "message": "..." }
  }
}
```

Each step's `status` is one of:
- `done`: ran and succeeded.
- `skipped`: its condition wasn't met (see `reason`). This is **not** an error.
- `failed`: Aquiline returned an error. The step has `stage`, `error` and `details` (for example `problemCode`).
- `not_run`: an earlier step failed, so this one never ran.

**Stops at the first failure.** `success` is `false` and `failedStep` names the failed step. The HTTP code is that step's error code (**402** plan · **502** Aquiline error · **504** timeout · **500** unexpected). Steps before it may already have succeeded, and the report shows which ones.

**HTTP 400** means the body failed validation, and nothing was sent to Aquiline. That response has the normal error shape `{ success:false, stage:"validation", ... }`.

**Safe to retry.** Profile and upsert are idempotent, and assign is skipped once the order has an AQUA number.

### Note on HTML
`outcome: "accepted"` means Aquiline **stored** the HTML and is still processing it (`trackingUpdateStatus: "processing"`). It does **not** mean the update was applied. `"applied"` means it was applied. Re-send new HTML about **1-2 times per day** using **Tracking → Upload Tracking HTML**.

request.description:
Makes sure the **profile** exists in Aquiline, then **upserts** the order(s). It does **not** assign tracking or upload HTML (use **Sync Full** for that).

### Aquiline calls
1. `GET /v1/profiles/{profileId}`: does the profile exist?
2. `POST /v1/profiles`: only if it doesn't. It's created with **your** `profileId`.
3. `POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/orders/upsert`: idempotent by `marketplaceOrderId`.

### Body

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `profileId` | ✅ | Your id for the Amazon account, e.g. `amazon-us-main`. Reused if it already exists. |
| `accountOrigin` | ✅ | Always `"amazon"`. |
| `label` | | Display name. |
| `marketplaceHost` | | e.g. `www.amazon.com`. |
| `retailer` | | e.g. `amazon-us`. |
| `amazonAccountEmail` | | Must be a valid email. Helps Aquiline's HTML refresh. |
| `storeAddress` | | Ship-from / return address. **Needed before Aquiline can assign tracking**, so set it on the first call. |
| `orders` | ✅ | Array, at least 1 item. See the order fields below. |

**Order fields:** `marketplaceOrderId` (✅), `orderId`, `orderPlacedAt`, `shipToName`, `shippingAddress`, `productTitle`, `productId`, `productUrl`, `productImageUrl`, `orderUrl`, `trackingUrl`, `sourceTracking`, `status`. Unknown order fields are rejected. Unknown top-level fields are silently dropped.

Profile fields are **only used when the profile is created**. They don't update an existing profile.

### Response
`profileCreated` shows whether step 2 ran. `ordersUpserted` is the count Aquiline reports.

item.name: Tracking
item.description: Individual tracking operations: assign, upload the daily HTML refresh, and look up an order. For a new order, use **Orders → Sync Full** instead.

request.description:
Read-only lookup of an order in Aquiline. It calls `GET /v1/profiles/{profileId}/orders/{orderId}`. **No cost.**

Use it to check whether an order already has an AQUA number (`aquilineNumber`) before assigning, or to read the current status.

### Path params
- `profileId`: profile id (`{{profileId}}`)
- `orderId`: Amazon order id (`{{orderId}}`)

### Response
`aquilineNumber` is `null` when the order hasn't been assigned yet. `order` is the full Aquiline order snapshot.

**404** (`stage: "get_tracking"`) means the order or profile doesn't exist in Aquiline. Sync it first.

request.description:
Registers the order with Aquiline tracking and returns its **AQUA number**. It calls Aquiline's `POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/orders/{orderId}/assign` and passes the body through as-is.

> ⚠️ **Counts against your Aquiline plan.** This endpoint does **not** check whether the order is already assigned. Use **Get Tracking** first, or use **Sync Full**, which skips already-assigned orders automatically.

The order must already be synced, and the profile should have a `storeAddress`.

### Body

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `profileId` | ✅ | |
| `orderId` | ✅ | Amazon order id. |
| `trackingUrl` | ✅ | The Amazon tracking page URL. |
| `retailer` | | e.g. `amazon-us`. |
| `marketplaceHost` | | e.g. `www.amazon.com`. |
| `sourceTracking` | | `"Amazon"`. |
| `amazonCustomerId` | | Optional. |
| `shippingAddress` | | Recipient address. |

### Response
`aquiline` is the AQUA tracking number. `chargedCents` / `planRemaining` show plan usage.

request.description:
Sends a new snapshot of the Amazon **tracking** page so Aquiline can update carrier and delivery milestones. It calls Aquiline's `POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/orders/{orderId}/tracking-html`.

**When:** about **1-2 times per day** per active order, while the buyer's Amazon session is still valid. The first upload can be done by **Sync Full**. Use this endpoint for the daily refreshes after that.

### Body

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `profileId` | ✅ | |
| `orderId` | ✅ | Amazon order id. |
| `trackingUrl` | ✅ | The ship-track URL the HTML was taken from. |
| `html` | ✅ | Full HTML of the **tracking** page (progress tracker) from a signed-in session. **Not** the order-details page. Max request 5 MB. |
| `amazonCustomerId` | | Optional. |

### Response: read `outcome`, not just `success`

| `outcome` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `accepted` | Stored and validated, **still processing** (`trackingUpdateStatus: "processing"`). **Not yet applied.** |
| `applied` | The update was applied to the AQUA tracking number. |

On a hard failure Aquiline returns a `problemCode`, which you'll find in `details.problemCode` (HTTP 502). Codes: `wrong_page_type`, `amazon_session_expired`, `tracking_url_mismatch`, `needs_tracking_upload`, `update_not_applied`, `assign_validation`, `shipment_exception`, `tracking_update_unavailable`.

- `amazon_session_expired`: the Amazon login is no longer valid. Sign in again and capture new HTML.
- `wrong_page_type`: you sent the order-details page instead of the tracking page.

response.name: 502 - Amazon session expired
